SELECT SUBSTR(B.PSG_FCLT_CD, 4, 1) AS DPTGT_NO, B.PSG_FCLT_NM AS DPTGT_NM, B.USE_YN FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_PSG_FCLT B WHERE 1 = 1 AND B.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId}
AND B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD IN ('LGT') ORDER BY DPTGT_NO

SELECT A.GATE_NO AS DPTGT_NO, A.FCLTY_CNT AS SCSH_CNTOM FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_FCLTY_OPNG_SCRTY_CNTRL_ATRB A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.SCRTY_CNTRL_ATRB_ID = REGEXP_REPLACE(#{scRsrcId}, 'FOTSC|FacilityOpeningTable_SecurityControl', '') AND A.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} ORDER BY DPTGT_NO

SELECT A.DPTGT_NO, A.OPER_YN AS OPR_YN, NVL(A.SCSH_CNTOM, 0) AS SCSH_CNTOM, NVL(A.GNRL_SRCH_CNTOM, 0) AS GNRL_SRCH_CNTOM, NVL(A.SMART_PASS_SRCH_CNTOM, 0) AS SMART_PASS_SRCH_CNTOM FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_USER_DPTGT A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.OWNER_USER_ID = #{loginUserId} AND A.EXCN_YMD = #{ymd} AND A.TMNL_ID = #{fcltTmnlId} ORDER BY A.DPTGT_NO

SELECT A.DPTGT_NO, A.PLAN_SN, NVL(A.OPER_BGNG_HOUR, 0) AS OPER_BGNG_HOUR, NVL(A.OPER_END_HOUR, 0) AS OPER_END_HOUR, NVL(A.SCSH_CNTOM, 0) AS SCSH_CNTOM FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_SCSH_OPER_PLAN A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.OWNER_USER_ID = #{loginUserId} AND A.EXCN_YMD = #{ymd} AND A.TMNL_ID = #{fcltTmnlId} ORDER BY A.DPTGT_NO, A.OPER_BGNG_HOUR
